article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
The Batu Caves
If you visit Malaysia's capital city, Kuala Lumpur, you really should visit the Batu Caves. They are only about 11 kilometres from the city and are easy to (21).................. by bus, train or taxi. There are plenty of transport (22).................. available.
At the entrance, there's a 43-metre high gold statue. Just past this, visitors will see 272 stairs to climb up to Temple Cave, one of the most popular tourist destinations in the world. In 2018, these stairs were painted bright colours and they now provide (23).................. of great photo opportunities. Most people climb the stairs in around 15 minutes. The climate is (24).................. hot and humid, however, so it is a very (25).................. idea to arrive early, when it is cooler. This also means you can avoid the worst of the crowds. Whenever you visit though, be (26).................. of the groups of monkeys which live there. They sometimes run off with visitors' phones or bags!

[--- Table Start ---]
| 21 | A reach | B travel | C arrive | D connect |
| 22 | A enquiries | B options | C ways | D decisions |
| 23 | A appearances | B descriptions | C times | D opportunities |
| 24 | A extremely | B totally | C exactly | D completely |
| 25 | A serious | B realistic | C sensible | D essential |
| 26 | A advised | B prepared | C planned | D organised |
[--- Table End ---]

questions.explanation:
A. reach
“easy to reach by bus” 表示 “乘公交容易到达”，“reach” 为及物动词，直接接地点，符合语境。
B. travel（旅行）需搭配 “to”；C. arrive（到达）需加 “at/in”；D. connect（连接）与 “到达” 无关。
拓展：“reach” 强调 “抵达某地”，近义词有 “arrive at/in”“get to”。

B. options
“transport options” 意为 “交通选择”，指可用的公交、火车等方式。
A. enquiries（询问）、C. ways（方法）、D. decisions（决定）均不与 “transport” 构成 “选择” 的含义。
拓展：“option” 表示 “可选择的事物”，如 “travel options（旅行选择）”。

D. opportunities
“provide opportunities of great photo opportunities” 指 “提供绝佳拍照机会”，“opportunities” 与 “机会” 对应。
A. appearances（外观）、B. descriptions（描述）、C. times（次数）均不符合 “拍照机会” 的语义。
拓展：“an opportunity to do sth.” 为固定搭配，如 “an opportunity to take photos（拍照的机会）”。

A. extremely
“extremely hot and humid” 表示 “极其湿热”，“extremely” 修饰形容词，强调程度。
B. totally（完全地）、C. exactly（确切地）、D. completely（彻底地）均不用于修饰 “hot” 的程度。
拓展：“extremely” 近义词为 “highly”“very”，如 “extremely popular（极其受欢迎）”。

C. sensible
“a sensible idea” 意为 “明智的主意”，指早到更凉爽，符合逻辑。
A. serious（严肃的）、B. realistic（现实的）、D. essential（必要的）均不如 “sensible” 贴切 “合理建议”。
拓展：“sensible” 侧重 “理智的、实用的”，如 “a sensible decision（明智的决定）”。

A. advised
“be advised of” 表示 “被提醒”，指游客被提醒注意猴子。
B. prepared（准备）、C. planned（计划）、D. organised（组织）均不与 “of” 搭配构成 “注意” 的含义。
拓展：“advise sb. to do sth.” 为常用结构，如 “advise visitors to be careful（建议游客小心）”。
